**The Problem You Know**
Your team switches between 6 systems to work a single lead. Calls are in one place, texts in another, CRM notes in a third. When you ask "what happened with that customer?" — nobody has the full picture. AI tools send notes that nobody reads. Follow-up depends on people remembering. People forget.

**What CXM Does**
CarBot Cloud CXM puts every call, text, email, and AI conversation into a single timeline per customer. AI handles the routine follow-through — scheduling appointments, sending confirmations, updating your CRM — so your team handles the relationships.

**Why It's Different**

| What You Get | Why It Matters |
|-------------|---------------|
| Unified conversation timeline | See the full customer story without switching systems |
| AI that follows through | Appointments schedule themselves after calls |
| ~20 interface themes | Your team uses the layout they already know |
| Real-time call intelligence | See what's happening on the floor from anywhere |
| Free for CarBot clients | No new budget line. No new vendor approval. |
